purpose: Pre-training readiness contract specifying what must be decided and locked before any OPS-01 training experiment (EXP-07) may begin. Items marked OPEN_PROTOCOL_DECISION must be resolved and approved by operator before execution.

preprocessing.normalization: OPEN_PROTOCOL_DECISION (must be computed on TRAIN only)
preprocessing.nodata_handling: OPEN_PROTOCOL_DECISION (no nodata currently in images; policy if encountered)

augmentation.prohibited_at_inference: Stochastic augmentation must not be applied to DEV or HOLDOUT at evaluation time

architecture.base: OPEN_PROTOCOL_DECISION (U-Net ResNet18 as in EXP-06 is one candidate)
architecture.note: EXP-06 was 2-channel 512x512 binary; EXP-07 architecture must be re-specified

loss_function.ops01_decision: OPEN_PROTOCOL_DECISION (must account for multi-class / severe imbalance)

evaluation_protocol.metric_definitions: OPEN_PROTOCOL_DECISION (must match Part-III evaluation protocol for comparable reporting)
evaluation_protocol.threshold_selection: DEV split ONLY — never on HOLDOUT
evaluation_protocol.holdout_evaluation: Single final evaluation, after threshold locked on DEV

rollback_policy: Any contamination of HOLDOUT before training completion requires experiment abort and new holdout
open_protocol_decisions_summary: OPEN-PREPROC-001: Value domain (raw DN vs dB vs sigma0)
OPEN-PREPROC-002: Normalization statistics (must compute on TRAIN only)
Architecture: input channels, spatial dims, output head
authorization_required_before_training: Operator sign-off on all OPEN_PROTOCOL_DECISION items
p3_training_readiness: CONDITIONAL_B — dataset ready, protocol requires completion
